s.how: Mash 100g soft butter with 5 crushed raw garlic cloves, chopped parsley and salt. Split a baguette, spread thickly, wrap in foil and bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Open the foil for the last 3 minutes to crisp.

s.note: the neighbour is always eating an apple
s.how: Slice 3 red apples and toss in lemon juice. Whip 150g peanut butter with 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt until light. Fan the apples around the dip. Don't invite anyone in without checking first.

m.note: enough garlic to keep Jerry out
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs skin side down. Add 40 unpeeled garlic cloves, thyme and 200ml white wine. Cover and bake at 180C for an hour. Squeeze the soft garlic onto slices of crusty bread and eat with the chicken.

w.note: blood red, but Jerry won't touch it
w.how: Bring 600ml thickened cream and 150g caster sugar to the boil and simmer 3 minutes. Take off the heat and stir in 120ml blood orange juice and the zest of 1 blood orange. Pour into 4 glasses and chill at least 4 hours until set. Top with thin slices of blood orange to serve.

d.n: Holy water lemon, lime and bitters
d.note: fill the little bottles before the neighbour visits
d.how: Squeeze 2 limes and 1 lemon. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice. Into each add 15ml lime juice, 10ml lemon juice and 4 dashes aromatic bitters. Top each with 200ml cold lemonade and stir once. Drop in a lime wedge. For the bottle look, mix it all in a jug and pour into 4 small glass bottles before serving over ice.
